collectionMethod: Manual capture of the official OpenCode Go documentation page (https://opencode.ai/docs/go/, which redirects to /docs/console/go/), the Go landing page (https://opencode.ai/go, served from /console/go), the OpenCode console changelog RSS feed (https://opencode.ai/console/changelog/rss.xml) and the full model catalog endpoint referenced by the documentation (https://opencode.ai/inference/go/v1/models), around 10:37 Beijing time / 02:37Z on 2026-11-16. The 2026-11-15 captures of the same docs page, landing page and RSS feed were compared byte for byte: the docs HTML and the RSS XML are byte-identical to 2026-11-15, and the landing page differs only in build-asset hashes and the model counter (32 → 33). The models API entry for id 'qwen4-max' was read as published and transcribed field by field. Research-only — no adopted row generated, no adopted value changed, no script changed.
scope: OpenCode Go official models interface only. The single change on 2026-11-16 is a new paid model 'Qwen4 Max' (model id qwen4-max) appearing in the models catalog API with a full three-part price, endpoint and limit set. The landing-page model counter moved from 'View all 32 models' to 'View all 33 models', while the allowance sentence remains 'Allowances for twelve Go models' and the banner remains 'Hy4 is now available in Go'. The official docs price tables (Go / Go Plus / Go Teams), the Monthly limit column, the 'Estimated requests' tables and the privacy table have no Qwen4 Max row yet, because the docs HTML is byte-identical to the 2026-11-15 capture. Research-only — not adopted; no adopted.csv row, no computed allowance, no script change, no leaderboard/score data.
adoptionStatus: research-only; not adopted; no opencode_go × qwen4-max row in adopted.csv yet — adding one requires an OPENCODE_GO_MODELS entry in scripts/build_adopted.py and a published Monthly limit, both left to maintainer review
